note: Own lexicon of the seo-content skill for Croatian pages of an EU shop, written 20.10.2026 from Reg. 1924/2006, 432/2012, 2015/2283, Dir. 2001/83/EC and the Croatian demand dossier (CBDSeoMarketResearch/HR/hr-market-2026-10-20: the market searches «protiv bolova», «za spavanje», «za anksioznost» — words a shop page must not use). Patterns run on lower-case text with č ć š ž stripped to c c s z; đ stays đ. fail = never on a shop page; fix = rewrite (fails in names, headings, questions and captions).

osjet na koži ili mjesto nanošenja: «gel za masažu s CBD-om i mentolom, osvježavajući osjet»
